from collections import deque
(n, k), a = map(int, input().split()), deque(map(int, input().split()))
if k >= n:
    print(max(a))
    exit()
cnt, w = 0, a.popleft()
while cnt < k:
    if w > a[0]:
        cnt += 1
        a.append(a.popleft())
    else:
        cnt = 0
        a.append(w)
        w = a.popleft()
print(w)
